title: Leo: what to know
description: The essentials of Leo in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Leo: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Jul 23 - Aug 22. Fire element, fixed quality, ruled by the Sun.

pages.title: Shine
pages.text: Leo has presence, generosity and a wish to inspire the people around.

pages.title: Pride
pages.text: Needs recognition and can be hurt easily. Appreciating others also brings shine.

pages.title: Warm and loyal
pages.text: Loves with celebration and affection in public. Expects to be valued the same way.

pages.title: The one who leads
pages.text: Likes to lead, present and motivate. Works best with room to create.
